normalization_rules.name: Whitespace Normalization
normalization_rules.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from all fields
normalization_rules.implementation: str.strip() applied to each field value

normalization_rules.name: Empty Value Standardization
normalization_rules.description: Represent missing values as empty strings (not nulls)
normalization_rules.implementation: Empty cells preserved as '' for TSV compatibility

normalization_rules.name: Field Name Standardization
normalization_rules.description: Use snake_case for all field names
normalization_rules.implementation: Object Date → date, Title → title, etc.

normalization_rules.name: Column Ordering
normalization_rules.description: Consistent field order across all records

normalization_rules.name: Character Encoding
normalization_rules.description: UTF-8 encoding maintained for all characters
normalization_rules.compliance: Supports international characters and special symbols

normalization_rules.name: Delimiter Consistency
normalization_rules.description: Tab character (U+0009) used as field delimiter

date_formats: Ancient dates: 4th–3rd century BCE, 5th century BCE

title_statistics.longest: Miss Foujere, from the Actresses series (N245) issued by Kinney Brothers to promote Sweet Caporal Cigarettes (109 chars)

checksum_verification.method_description: Each row's data is converted to tab-separated format and hashed independently
checksum_verification.source_checksum_formula: SHA-256(Original Date \t Original Title \t Original Object Number \t Original URL)
checksum_verification.std_checksum_formula: SHA-256(Standardized Date \t Standardized Title \t Standardized Object Number \t Standardized URL)
verification_process: 2. For each row, extract data fields (excluding checksums)
3. Reconstruct tab-separated string in canonical order
4. Calculate SHA-256 hash of reconstructed string
5. Compare calculated hash with recorded std_checksum
6. Report any mismatches as data integrity issues

standardized_tsv.header: row_number	date	title	object_number	url	source_checksum	std_checksum

fixity_preservation_strategy.level_1_checksums: Record-level SHA-256 for source and standardized data
fixity_preservation_strategy.level_2_field_tracking: Individual field values preserved exactly as provided
fixity_preservation_strategy.level_3_transformation_audit: Complete mapping of source → standardized field names
fixity_preservation_strategy.level_4_reproducibility: Python script enables independent recalculation of all checksums
fixity_preservation_strategy.level_5_documentation: This manifest provides complete transparency of all operations

Filter records based on data quality metrics in report
Reference object_number as primary key (100% complete)
Resolve URLs directly to Met Museum collection database

Recalculate std_checksums using provided Python script
Use checksums.tsv for spot-checking individual records
